mantras.text: The day is already mine. One true thing or full rest. Nothing between is the trap.
The rut is not cowardice. It is a neurochemical circuit built rationally, under real pressure, that costs more than it saves.
A dolphin is not performing its membership in the ocean. It moves through it, leaves it, returns — without the return being a fresh start.
Presence is not a reward for finishing. It is the thing itself.
The goal isn't to be a land animal. It's to build a tank so you can carry your water with you.
Standing up straight with your shoulders back is not something that is only physical — you are a spirit as well. It means voluntarily accepting the burden of Being.
I have no choice but to make a conscious choice not to rut. The turning point is already decided. The only variable is when I step into it.
mantras.source: No Choice But to Make a Choice — 29.10.25

mantras.text: Social stratification is a bound. Predefined periods of work and rest are bounds. Conformity is a bound. Be boundless.
Everything matters. A sale means money to escape debt. Even leaving glasses on the bedside table before bed counts for something.
Joy and beauty — simply from unconstraining the mind and letting it roam free. Be serendipitous and spontaneous.
Remove the first rung. You don't fight the slope from the bottom.
I can feel the birds chirping, I can feel the sunshine, I can feel the cars hustle and bustle. I also have my body. That is enough.
